harmonization.method: MODIS observed while MODIS delivers data; afterwards MODIS-equivalent expected fire cell-days estimated from VIIRS (LightGBM cross-fitted by year blocks on the years of stable MODIS orbits, calibrated per biome, coverage gap added back).

layers.method: VIIRS split in two layers that add up, not rescaled: the common layer is the MODIS-equivalent estimate (fire both sensors can see, continuous since 2000); the VIIRS-only layer is 1 - P(MODIS also sees it) on each cell-day the estimating satellite saw fire (small fires only VIIRS detects, from 2012). Common + VIIRS-only is the expected number of cell-days with fire seen by MODIS or by that satellite.

check.target: cell-days with fire seen by MODIS or S-NPP
